hints.title: Cartesian Product of Students and Subjects
hints.text: Every student must be paired with every subject, even if they attended zero examinations for that subject.

hints.title: Cross Join with Left Join Counting
hints.text: cross join Students with Subjects, then left join with Examinations to count exam attendance.

hints.title: Students and Examinations Blueprint
hints.text: select s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name, count(e.subject_name) as attended_exams from Students s cross join Subjects sub left join Examinations e on s.student_id = e.student_id and sub.subject_name = e.subject_name group by s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name order by s.student_id, sub.subject_name.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name, COUNT(e.subject_name) AS attended_exams
FROM Students s
CROSS JOIN Subjects sub
LEFT JOIN Examinations e ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND sub.subject_name = e.subject_name
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name
ORDER BY s.student_id, sub.subject_name;
```

complexity.notes: Cross join constructs S * B base rows, joined with E attendance records.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple inner join on Examinations omits students who took zero exams for a subject.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Cross join guarantees complete dimensional grid prior to left aggregation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of cross join with left join and count on joined column to preserve zero counts.

solutions.code:
SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name, COUNT(e.subject_name) AS attended_exams
FROM Students s
CROSS JOIN Subjects sub
LEFT JOIN Examinations e ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND sub.subject_name = e.subject_name
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, sub.subject_name
ORDER BY s.student_id, sub.subject_name;

import pandas as pd

def students_and_examinations(students: pd.DataFrame, subjects: pd.DataFrame, examinations: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    grid = students.merge(subjects, how='cross')
    exam_counts = examinations.groupby(['student_id', 'subject_name']).size().reset_index(name='attended_exams')
    res = grid.merge(exam_counts, on=['student_id', 'subject_name'], how='left')
    res['attended_exams'] = res['attended_exams'].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return res.sort_values(by=['student_id', 'subject_name'])
solutions.approach: Pandas Cross Merge and Left Join Fillna
